semantics.conv: raw BF16 QKV history, oldest-to-current depthwise weights, FP32 accumulation, SiLU, BF16 output/state storage
semantics.qk: FP32 L2 normalization with epsilon 1e-6 and inverse-sqrt key-dim Q scale
semantics.gates: FP32 decay and update beta from FP32-promoted BF16 inputs
semantics.recurrence: FP32 decay, prediction, beta delta, outer update, then output from updated [V,K] state
semantics.state: immutable paired BF16 conv plus FP32 recurrent result
semantics.inactive: inactive inputs/states not numerically read; output tail zero

continuity.segmented_prefill: exact output and both final states equal one-shot
continuity.token_decode: exact output and both final states equal one-shot

validation.caller_snapshot: all tensor and metadata sequences read once before validation/consumption
